notes.title: Huge November Sale!!!
notes.content:
We are having a huge sale on Polarity this week!  

One of the most fun puzzle/platformers since Portal. Polarity takes it to the next level, demanding all of your wits and reflexes. Full-featured local co-op campaign.

notes.title: New Improved Controls
notes.content: Switching polarities and running are now easier than ever in this new update.

notes.title: Update 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Well it's live as of today, I hope you enjoy it!

Fixes:

-Bonus 01 fixed
-Story 02 fixed
-Sprint now on toggle
-Mouse can be used to click levels on front end
-Third fragment on "Jigsaw" now appears
-Data fragment indicator added to main HUD

notes.title: Update 1.1 coming soon!
notes.content:
So the first Polarity update is upon us, I've heard the feedback from the community and have made various fixes/improvements.

The first patch will contain the following fixes:

- Story 02 no longer black screens for some people
- Source Controller achievement fixed
- Sprint is now a toggle
- Data collected indicator now also visible on the main HUD
- On the final single player level the mini-wall now has collision
- Levels can now be clicked on to select them in the front end

Some people are still having issues with Bonus 01, when I get some more solid reports on that I will fix it, in the meantime I hope this addresses some of the issues the community has brought up.

Thanks!

notes.title: Bring your friends, November 7th is the day to cube it up
notes.content:
Polarity is coming out!....on November 7th.

Yep, that's about it. There's a ton of levels, content, a multi-player cooperative campaign, there's also a weird pseudo basketball mode you can play with your buddies because fun.

Oh and don't forget the wafer thin storyline! it's back and more wafery than ever.

There's particles...everybody likes particles.

Good luck, we hope you enjoy it.
